stories.title: Supreme Court declines to hear challenge to Maryland "sensitive places" gun law
stories.summary: The Supreme Court declined Monday to consider a challenge to a Maryland law restricting where people can carry guns.

stories.title: Baltimore County volunteer firefighter pleads guilty while maintaining innocence in groping case
stories.summary: A Baltimore County volunteer firefighter maintained his innocence but acknowledged that prosecutors had enough evidence to secure a conviction on charges of groping a co-worker, according to The Baltimore Banner, CBS News Baltimore's media partner.

stories.title: Firefighters battle large fire involving multiple rowhomes in South Baltimore
stories.summary: Firefighters battled a large fire involving multiple rowhomes Monday evening in South Baltimore.

stories.title: Major U.S. banks report widespread service outages
stories.summary: Customers at JPMorgan Chase U.S. Bank and other major financial institutions reported difficulty accessing their accounts.

stories.title: Maryland man sentenced to 33 months for impaired driving at 102 mph, killing father of five
stories.summary: A Maryland man was sentenced to 33 months in federal prison for driving under the influence and causing a head-on crash that killed a father of five on the Baltimore-Washington Parkway in Howard County.

stories.title: Annapolis community rallies behind family after deadly townhome fire
stories.summary: An Annapolis community is rallying behind a family after a fire at a townhome Sunday ​morning left one person dead and another critically injured.

stories.title: Cold mornings, pleasant afternoons this week in Maryland
stories.summary: Many neighborhoods recorded the first freeze of the season on Monday morning.

stories.title: Shooting in Baltimore injures 4 men in Central Park Heights neighborhood, police say
stories.summary: A shooting in Baltimore's Central Park Heights neighborhood on Monday afternoon injured four men, according to the Baltimore Police Department (BPD).

stories.title: Baltimore music community remembers rapper killed in shooting outside shopping center
stories.summary: The Baltimore music community is remembering 26-year-old Maleek Smith after he was shot and killed outside the Hilltop Shopping Center on Sunday afternoon.

stories.title: Calvin Ball steps down as Howard County executive, reflects on his legacy
stories.summary: Calvin Ball has stepped down as Howard County executive, effective immediately, as he prepares to take on his new role as interim president of Baltimore City Community College.
